status: PROSPECTIVE DRAFT for review. NOT a policy, NOT a GO template, NOT executable. Zero physical calculations are authorized by this file.
purpose: Two future fixed-geometry physical equivalence calculations at the LP2-B1 selected bank seed spacing, against the original accepted LP2-A3 records of the SAME geometry and material, before any continuation of soft1 beyond S9 may be proposed.
selectionEvidence: LP2-B1 WP1 attempt 2 (amendment A1): first preregistered candidate passing all 19 checks on the soft1 S10 target; deterministic repeat; references soft1 S9 and H S10 pass 19/19 at 0.40 mm

solves.mesh: g2_lp2a2_join(...,SeedSpacing_mm 0.40) + pairing + g2_lp1_audit; canonical array digest must equal the LP2-B1 record of R_soft1_S9_h040 before the solve

nextPredictor.source: signed-MTS 4-mm forecast from the archived soft1 S9 K (= stored TERMINAL candidate and failed-mesh polyline)

solves.mesh: g2_lp2a2_join(...,SeedSpacing_mm 0.40) + pairing + g2_lp1_audit; canonical array digest must equal the LP2-B1 record of R_H_S10_h040 before the solve

nextPredictor.source: accepted H S11 STATE tip (591c894b...) = signed-MTS 4-mm forecast from the archived H S10 K

solveRules.globalStop: stop at the first failure of any criterion, gate or integrity check; the second solve is not run

criteria.source: inherited WP5 C1-C11 (G2_LP2A2_EQ_POLICY_v1.json, g2_lp2a2_eq_compare) with identical numerical thresholds
criteria.C7_EDI_spread_quadrature: path spread <= max(1e-5, 5 x archived); 4x4 quadrature <= max(1e-5, 5 x archived)
criteria.C8_crackOpening: near-tip jump (identical node positions <= 3.3 mm) <= 1e-3 of the near-tip maximum; whole-crack jump (archived interpolated to new stations) <= 2e-3 of the maximum
criteria.C9_phaseActivation: solver gates pass, 76 chords per circle as archived, active area relative difference <= 1e-9 (H S10: archived active area 0 -> new active area must be 0)
criteria.C10_nextPredictor: |new next-tip forecast - archived next tip| <= 5e-4 mm, with the STATE-SPECIFIC next state (S10 for soft1 S9, S11 for H S10), never a hard-coded S9
criteria.reporting: full signed differences of every quantity, also when within tolerance; signed normal opening reported (not a criterion), as in WP5

excludedComparisons.contrast: no F_G or MTS contrast criterion: the two references differ in arclength (61.4 vs 65.4 mm) and architecture, so no same-s contrast exists; no multi-architecture contrast qualification is claimed. A same-s contrast test would need a separately predeclared, correctly matched reference pair and its own review.
excludedComparisons.targetPhysics: no estimate of the soft1 S10 G, signed SIF or MTS angle from mesh quality or from these two solves

interpretation.EQUIVALENT_AT_0p40: both solves pass C1-C11: the 0.40 mm family reproduces the accepted 0.45 mm results on these two fixed geometries within the inherited tolerances. Numerical equivalence on two geometries; not a discretization-error bound, not a convergence statement, not a multi-architecture qualification.
interpretation.NOT_EQUIVALENT: any failure: HOLD; 0.40 mm may not be used for continuation until a separate review explains the difference; no retry, no tolerance change after a solve.
interpretation.after: only after EQUIVALENT_AT_0p40 and review may a separate new campaign seek authorization to solve the actual soft1 S10 candidate at exactly 0.40 mm, as a prospective continuation of the original soft1 S9 (not a resumption of the revoked LP2-A3). S11 and beyond are unknown and not authorized by this.
